description: Returns one family- or employment-based cutoff from a month's State Department Visa Bulletin: the Final Action Date or Date for Filing for a preference category and chargeability country. Use it when the user asks whether a priority date is current. date_or_status is a YYYY-MM-DD cutoff, "C" (current), or "U" (unavailable). For Diversity Visa lottery cutoffs, use get_visa_bulletin_dv. For the bulletin's advisory notes on future movement, use get_visa_bulletin_notes. A month or combination not on file returns not_found. Requires sign-in at https://immigrationlayer.com/login and an active plan. Without a plan it returns subscription_required. Limit: 30 calls per minute per account, shared by all paid tools, then rate_limited. Not legal advice. Source: the Department of State Visa Bulletin (travel.state.gov).

category.description: Preference category code, exact: F1, F2A, F2B, F3, F4, EB-1, EB-2, EB-3, EB-3-OW (other workers), EB-4, EB-4-R (religious workers), EB-5 (unreserved), EB-5-RURAL, EB-5-HUA (high unemployment), or EB-5-INFRA

chart.description: "final_action" for the Final Action Dates chart, "dates_for_filing" for the Dates for Filing chart

country.description: Chargeability country, exact: "China" (mainland-born), "India", "Mexico", "Philippines", or "All Chargeability Areas" for every other country

month.description: Bulletin month as YYYY-MM, e.g. "2026-10". A month not yet published or loaded returns not_found

name: get_visa_bulletin

date_or_status.description: Cutoff date as YYYY-MM-DD, "C" (current: no wait), or "U" (unavailable)

title: Get Visa Bulletin chart entry
